data_point: Actively hiring across several open roles
run_when: A careers page was found but roles couldn't be counted from a job board.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company is actively hiring across several open roles at once (3 or more).
prompt.definition: Headcount growth drives payroll complexity and is the best public proxy for fast growth.
unknown_when: Roles not visible in the text
watch_out_for: Same role in several locations counts once

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.
